The change keeps **R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY**, **R-DISCOUNT-PERCENT**, and **R-DISCOUNT-CAP** true. No risk or threat control item was touched. `node --test src/pricing.test.ts` passed all 8 tests, including “rejects an expired code,” “rejects a code at its exact expiry,” and “caps at fifty percent.”
